purpose: Coordinate-free style tendencies derived across the supplied reference corpus; never a character-costume or insignia template.

evidence: tan jacket and olive inner layer
warm brown olive cream charcoal family

preferredRenderer.reason: Structured collars, split panels, yokes, and side-view layering need the existing 16x16 Scale-2 construction budget.

SUBTLE.intent: Ordinary Stardew clothing with one fieldwear cue.

MODERATE.intent: Clearly related military/civilian fieldwear through construction and palette.

STRONG.intent: The strongest legal cropped-field-jacket or fitted-uniform construction without insignia or costume replication.
STRONG.antiCosplayLimit: Use corpus-level jacket grammar only; never reproduce emblems, exact pocket maps, or exact harness layouts.

semanticTendencies.contrast: Dark outline and recesses; mid-value rugged outer cloth; clearly separated inner layer or yoke; restrained highlights.

traits: long-coat influence simplified to standard supported torso length

frozenVocabularySimplifications.croppedJacket: Use the compact JACKET archetype with a structured hem and strong waist termination; the frozen renderer has no separate cropped-length field.
frozenVocabularySimplifications.pocketFlaps: Represent only through existing major panel hierarchy; no unsupported pocket pixels are added.
frozenVocabularySimplifications.harnessRhythm: Reduce to one existing placket, yoke, or lower-band gesture; never draw freehand straps.
frozenVocabularySimplifications.longCoat: Translate to dark formal torso outerwear because the frozen shirt backend has no long-coat silhouette.
frozenVocabularySimplifications.vest: Translate to fitted BUTTON_SHIRT yoke/overlay construction with native sleeves preserved.
